role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 巨魔战将可以在近战和远程攻击之间切换自如，无论远近他都是强大的力量。有着双斧在手，他的出击往往伴随着风暴般的旋刃。敌人很难抵挡他愈发迅捷的攻击，而他无论身在何方都可以帮助盟友发动猛击。
hero_summary_en: Instantly able to swap between ranged and melee attacks, Troll Warlord is a formidable force at any distance. Axes in hand, he can strike in a storm of spinning blades. He takes down enemies with increasingly swift attacks, and can speed his allies' assaults wherever they are.

abilities.name: troll_warlord_switch_stance
abilities.description_zh: 巨魔战将从使用远程攻击切换为近战攻击。近战下巨魔战将的基础攻击间隔降低至%base_attack_time%。巨魔战将每拥有%attack_speed_interval%攻击速度加成获得%armor_per_interval%点护甲。
abilities.description_en: Troll Warlord swaps from using ranged to melee attacks. While melee, Troll Warlord's base attack time is improved to %base_attack_time%.Troll Warlord gains %armor_per_interval% armor per %attack_speed_interval% bonus attack speed.

abilities.name: troll_warlord_whirling_axes_ranged
abilities.description_zh: 巨魔战将掷出手中的五把飞斧，减速并伤害前方%axe_range%范围锥形区域内的敌方单位。
abilities.description_en: Troll hurls a fistful of five axes in a cone shape over %axe_range% range, slowing and damaging enemy units.
notes_zh: 不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。
notes_en: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

scepter_loc.en: Causes Whirling Axes (Ranged) to dispel enemies. Reduces cooldown and mana cost.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
scepter_loc.zh: 旋风飞斧（远程）可以驱散敌人。降低冷却时间和魔法消耗。驱散类型：弱驱散

abilities.name: troll_warlord_whirling_axes_melee
abilities.description_zh: 巨魔战将掷出两把飞斧环绕在他周围，使敌方单位受到伤害，并且部分普通攻击将不能命中。
abilities.description_en: Troll hurls two axes around him in a close range area of effect, damaging enemy units and causing them to miss some attacks.

scepter_loc.en: Causes Whirling Axes (Melee) to dispel Troll Warlord. Reduces cooldown and mana cost.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
scepter_loc.zh: 旋风飞斧（近战）可以驱散自己。降低冷却时间和魔法消耗。驱散类型：弱驱散

abilities.name: troll_warlord_fervor
abilities.description_zh: 当巨魔战将持续攻击同一个目标时，他会攻击得越来越快。如果改变目标，则额外的攻速加成清零。
abilities.description_en: With each continuous blow on the same target, Troll gains increased attack speed.  If Troll changes targets, the stacks drop to zero.
notes_zh: 破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏会使阿哈利姆魔晶的几率触发失效。
notes_en: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break disables the proc chance granted by Aghanim's Shard.

shard_loc.en: Grants Troll %base_chance%%% + %extra_attack_chance_per_stack%%% chance per Fervor stack of firing an additional ranged attack to any unit within its ranged attack range plus %range_buffer% when attacking an enemy unit.
shard_loc.zh: 巨魔战将在攻击敌方单位时拥有%base_chance%%% + 热血战魂叠加次数*%extra_attack_chance_per_stack%%%的几率对远程攻击距离 + %range_buffer%范围内任意单位发动一次额外的远程攻击。

facet_text_en: Fervor grants armor per stack while in melee form.
facet_text_zh: 近战形态下热血战魂的叠加效果提供护甲。

abilities.name: troll_warlord_berserkers_rage
abilities.description_zh: 近战形态下巨魔战将的攻击有几率触发诱捕，阻止目标移动或使用位移类技能。另外近战形态下还拥有额外移动速度。远程形态下巨魔战将的攻击有几率使目标残废，造成额外伤害，并且降低目标的移动和攻击速度。
abilities.description_en: While in melee form, Troll Warlord's attacks have a chance to ensnare, preventing the target from moving or using mobility spells and has additional movement speed.When in ranged form, Troll Warlord's attacks have a chance to Maim the target, dealing bonus damage, and slowing the target's movement and attack speed.

abilities.name: troll_warlord_battle_trance
abilities.description_zh:
巨魔战将释放出强大的战斗专注，强迫自身持续攻击%range%距离内最近的敌方单位，以英雄优先。专注期间不会因伤害而阵亡。提供额外吸血，攻击速度，减速抗性和移动速度。施放时施加弱驱散。 

驱散类型：弱驱散
abilities.description_en:
Troll unleashes a powerful battle trance, that forces you to continuously attack the closest enemy unit within %range% range, prioritizing heroes. Damage does not kill you during this mode. Grants you bonus lifesteal, attack speed, slow resistance and movement speed. Applies a Basic Dispel.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes_zh: 巨魔战将在战斗专注作用下仍然可以使用他的物品技能，但是无法执行其他指令。
斧王的淘汰之刃还是能斩杀巨魔战将。
巨魔战将会获得目标的视野。
notes_en: Troll can still use his items and abilities while affected by Battle Trance, but not other commands.
Troll can still be killed with Axe's Culling Blade.
Troll is granted vision over the target.
facet_text_en: During Battle Trance, Troll Warlord has increased max Fervor stacks and no attack speed limit. Battle Trance grants allied heroes %attack_speed_share_percent%%% of the attack speed bonus.
facet_text_zh: 战斗专注期间巨魔战将的热血战魂叠加层数上限变高，而且没有攻击速度上限。战斗专注为友方英雄提供%attack_speed_share_percent%%%攻击速度加成。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_troll_warlord_battle_trance_movespeed
talents_raw.name_loc: Allies Receive Battle Trance Attack Speed

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_troll_warlord_4
talents_raw.desc_loc: Can be cast while stunned and applies a strong dispel to Troll Warlord.
